themes.evidence: The people we serve are at the heart of everything we do.
To deliver on our mission and drive market share acceleration, we have launched our Total Home Strategy.
Every aspect of our business and strategy is rooted in that mission.
Building upon our strong foundation, we will focus on five key areas: Pro, Online, Installation Services, Localization and Assortment.

linguistic_shift: Sentences ADDED: 'Together, we deliver the right home improvement products, with the best service and value, across every channel and community we serve.'
analyst_notes: The Total Home Strategy and its focus areas have been introduced, but the core values remain unchanged.
